scenes.sceneGoal: Establish DubbingAI, Discord, and the support scale before the overload begins.
staticStates: Opening frame: editorial headline block on the left with DubbingAI and 30K-member Discord community.
Mid-state: a Discord-like thread field expands on the right with several visible conversations at different depths.
Hold state: the frame clearly communicates customer, platform, and scale.
Exit state: unresolved density begins to build on the right.
motionSteps: Threads slide in from staggered offsets and settle into a structured cluster.
Unread indicators and line pulses wake up softly as threads arrive.
The dot-grid texture drifts subtly to keep the field alive.
Right-side density increases just before the transition out.

timing.hold: A clean readable hold after the thread cluster settles

copySlots.headline: DubbingAI
copySlots.body: A fast-growing product community where support volume started outpacing the team.

scenes.sceneGoal: Show repeated support work piling up faster than the small human team can absorb it.
staticStates: Opening frame: threads from scene setup remain, but more unresolved cards are stacked.
Mid-state: repeated question cards dominate the left while a three-person operator lane sits on the right.
Hold state: repeated questions, escalation burden, and a small on-call team are all readable.
Exit state: the queue freezes in a too-much-work state.
motionSteps: Question cards stack upward and forward in staggered waves.
Three operator markers light up one by one and remain pinned.
Escalation flags appear on selected cards and stay visible.
A short pause lands before Lucius enters.

timing.hold: Freeze on overloaded queue before Lucius enters

copySlots.headline: The same questions kept coming back.
copySlots.body: Repeated setup questions, escalation burden, and a small team staying on-call all the time.

scenes.sceneGoal: Position Lucius inside the workflow as the system that turns noisy support activity into reusable structure.
staticStates: Opening frame: queue density remains and the Lucius node is only partially visible.
Mid-state: a three-column frame shows live inputs on the left, Lucius in the center, and structured outputs on the right.
Hold state: Lucius is visibly inside the workflow and both inputs and outputs are readable.
Exit state: structured notes stabilize and prepare the learning-loop explanation.
motionSteps: Repeated question cards collapse into signal chips that travel into the Lucius node.
Structured notes re-emerge on the right in a short stagger.
Connector lines draw only after the chip movement is established.
A few input chips continue drifting while the outputs settle.

timing.hold: A stable three-column hold with readable inputs and outputs

assetBindings.usage: Center Lucius node and brand anchor

copySlots.headline: Lucius learns from actual community behavior.
copySlots.body: Repeated questions become structured support logic. Noisy activity resolves into reusable patterns.

scenes.sceneGoal: Explain why Lucius improves over time instead of behaving like a frozen rules bot.
staticStates: Opening frame: one anchor card appears first while the rest of the loop is absent.
Mid-state: four linked cards assemble into a readable system loop.
Hold state: the full loop is assembled and readable after one complete cycle.
Exit state: the final loop token moves toward the results scene.
motionSteps: Cards assemble from dispersed positions into a loop.
A single signal token travels through the steps in order.
Each card wakes up when the token reaches it and then settles.
Connectors brighten only while active.

timing.hold: One clean assembled-loop hold after a single cycle

scenes.sceneGoal: Land the operating-model change through restrained, readable proof points.
staticStates: Opening frame: the learning loop recedes into a structured background.
Mid-state: a balanced field presents five metrics and one results statement.
Hold state: all five metrics are readable without competition.
Exit state: metrics soften while a human quote anchor begins to emerge.
motionSteps: Metric tiles rise or lock into place one by one with restrained stagger.
The 3 -> 0 tile animates as a reduction instead of a generic pop-in.
The 80% tile settles with understated fill behavior.
The metric field gently recedes to make space for the quote.

scenes.sceneGoal: Turn the operational result into a human outcome: real relief while support keeps running.
staticStates: Opening frame: metrics from the previous scene remain faintly in the background.
Mid-state: a large editorial quote sits left while a calm support panel sits right.
Hold state: quote and panel are both readable together.
Exit state: the support panel reduces into minimal structure and the quote fades gently.
motionSteps: Overloaded system language dissolves into a calmer operating panel.
Support panel rows pulse softly to show continuity.
The holiday marker arrives late as the emotional payoff.
The scene breathes with slow, spacious motion.

timing.hold: A relief-focused hold with calm continuity

copySlots.quote: Lucius basically gave me my holidays back.
labels: Team on holiday. Support still running.

scenes.sceneGoal: End on the broader principle: better support creates the conditions for a living community.
staticStates: Opening frame: geometry from the human outcome scene is still faintly visible.
Mid-state: four stable channel bars sit opposite the final principle line.
Hold state: the principle remains on screen for the longest clean read in the sequence.
Exit state: no CTA; the scene ends in stability.
motionSteps: Dense support geometry collapses into four stable channel bars.
The dot-field reorders itself lightly as the structure simplifies.
Channel bars settle one by one.
The final editorial headline resolves in with confidence, not drama.

timing.hold: Longest clean read of the sequence

copySlots.headline: Better support keeps the room alive.
copySlots.supportCopy: Lucius helps create the conditions for a living community that can sustain participation.
